correctness.rationale: Definitions are exact; the source game/graph equivalence and Catalan enumeration are invoked within their hypotheses. The \(c_m\) formula follows from the 2010 primary theorem. A central-binomial lower bound gives at least \(n/m\) connected types at block size \(m=\lceil\log_4 n+4\log_4(\log n)\rceil\). Distinct connected types make \(r!\) different but isomorphic legal order ideals. The squared class mass and Stirling prove the unconditional limit. Exhaustive checks at \(1\le n\le6\) and selected numerical supply cases corroborate, but are not used to extrapolate.
